AviaOne

AviaOne.com 🟢 is a trusted professional validator since 2021 with security-focused infrastructure, having contributed to the development of Gno.land code.

Until 2024, we operated over 50 nodes, including more than 20 mainnets. 2024 has been a challenging year for the blockchain validation industry. Rather than spreading resources thin across many networks, AviaOne has made the strategic decision to focus on fewer, high-quality blockchain partnerships.

Our main contribution to the Cosmos ecosystem is [AviaOne BlockChains Service (ABS)](https://aviaone.com/blockchains-service/), a live index and verification engine for 370+ Cosmos blockchains (mainnets and testnets). It tests RPC/API endpoints, latency and binary versions every 3 hours, and provides interactive node setup guides and CLI resources for developers and operators.

We have participated in all Gno.land testnets and contributed to the core codebase by introducing the [seed node mechanism](https://github.com/gnolang/gno/pull/6023) used by validators to interconnect.

We maintain [Tenderseed](https://github.com/AviaOne/tenderseed), a tool to deploy seed nodes across Cosmos SDK and Gno.land chains, and [GnoDuty](https://github.com/AviaOne/GnoDuty), a monitoring tool that tracks validator activity in real time, running live on [our own node](https://gnoduty.aviaone.com/).

### Why validating on Gno.land

As active validators since 2021, we believe Gno.land opens new horizons for next-generation blockchains, and we did not want to miss such a milestone.

### Networks we currently validate

- AtomOne
- Fetch.ai
- Gno.land

### Digital presence

- [aviaone.com](https://aviaone.com/)
- [x.com/avia_one](https://x.com/avia_one)

### Infrastructure

Data center in Germany. AMD Ryzen 7 3700X, 64 GB DDR4 ECC, 2 x 1 TB NVMe in RAID 1. Hardware quality is never traded away.

We operate infrastructure with a strong emphasis on stability, security, observability, and practical day-to-day network support. # Beezee
## Validator Description
BZE Community is the team behind BeeZee, a sovereign Cosmos SDK blockchain focused on fast, cost-efficient, and community-driven decentralized services.
BeeZee has practical experience operating and maintaining blockchain infrastructure, supporting its own network, working with Cosmos SDK-based technology, and participating in the broader interchain ecosystem. As an IBC-enabled chain, BeeZee understands the importance of reliable validators, public infrastructure, stable node operations, and long-term ecosystem support.
## Why BZE Community Is Interested in Validating on gno.land
BZE Community is interested in validating on gno.land because of its fresh approach to smart contract development through Gno, a Go-like language designed for transparent, auditable, and composable on-chain applications.
As a Cosmos SDK-based project, BeeZee sees gno.land as a natural and important evolution within the broader interchain ecosystem. The focus on readable source code, developer accessibility, and transparent smart contracts aligns well with the values of open blockchain infrastructure.
## Contributions to gno.land
BZE Community can contribute to gno.land through:
- Validator operation
- Participation in testnets
- Operational feedback from a Cosmos SDK project perspective
- Public infrastructure support where applicable
- Community awareness and ecosystem support
- Technical testing of upgrades and validator workflows
- Feedback on developer and operator experience
- Long-term participation in the gno.land ecosystem
## Relevant BZE Community Experience
BeeZee Project has practical experience with:
- Operating a sovereign Cosmos SDK blockchain
- Blockchain infrastructure maintenance
- Validator and node operations
- Network upgrades
- IBC-enabled ecosystem participation
- Community-driven blockchain development
- Public chain services
- Ecosystem communication and technical support
## Summary
BZE Community would like to support gno.land as a reliable validator and ecosystem participant.

Validator Name: Apollo

Networks Validated:
Mainnet: AtomOne, Celestia, Bitway, Jackal, Axone, Arkeo, Realio, Massa, Quicksilver, Nomic, Terp etc.
Testnet: AtomOne, Celestia, Axone, Arkeo, Kira, Cardchain, Nomic etc.
Total Assets Under Management (AuM): approximately $500,000.

Digital Presence & Contacts:
- Web-site: https://apollo-validator.eu/
- X (Twitter): https://x.com/petr_zelivsky
- GitHub: https://github.com/Zelivsky
- Telegram: @Zelivsky
- Discord: zelivsky
- Email: apollo.validator@gmail.com

Why I Am Interested in Validating on Gno.land:
Gno.land represents one of the few truly innovative and ideological blockchain projects in the current landscape. I am particularly drawn to its technical novelties — the Gnolang language and the Proof of Contribution concept — as well as to the philosophical foundation laid by Jae Kwon, whose ideas on decentralization deeply resonate with me.
In an age of increasing corporate control over technology and data, I believe Gno.land embodies the effort to preserve autonomy, transparency, and the open nature of the internet. Supporting this project means supporting the freedom of digital communities to self-govern, innovate, and evolve independently of centralized powers.

Contributions to Gno.land:
I actively participate in the Gno.land testnet, running a stable validator node and helping strengthen the network’s resilience and decentralization. I also share technical knowledge and updates within the validator community, contributing to the project’s visibility and understanding. In addition, I am committed to providing reliable infrastructure, maintaining uptime, and assisting new participants by sharing operational experience.

Summary:
Apollo is an independent validator driven by genuine belief in decentralization and technological progress. Through participation in Gno.land, I aim to contribute both technically and ideologically to a more transparent and self-organizing digital world.

StakeUp

StakeUp is a staking provider and validator team operating blockchain infrastructure since 2021. We focus on stable validator operations, network participation, infrastructure support, and long-term ecosystem support. 

## Network
We currently operate validators across more than 30 blockchain networks, including: 
- Atomone 
- Celestia
- Cosmos 
- Canton
- Dymension
- Starknet
- Near
- Shentu
- Doravota
- Espresso
- Nym
- Provenance
- Haqq
- Pocket
- Bitway,
- Warden and others. 

## Links: 
- Website: https://stakeup.tech
- X (Twitter): https://x.com/stakeup_tech

## Contact Details: 
- Email: contact@stakeup.tech
- Telegram: https://t.me/stakeup_team
- Discord: landerosua

## Why We're Interested in Validating on gno.land: 
We have been participating in blockchain ecosystems and operating validators for several years. gno.land is an interesting ecosystem, and we would like to contribute by running reliable infrastructure and supporting the network as it develops. 

## Contributions: 
- Participation in testnets and network testing, 
- Providing public services such as RPC, API, and snapshots, 
- Developing tools and dashboards, 
- Supporting network upgrades and validator operations.
